acceptanceCriteriaVerified: Given a live environment with an empty database, when accessing the public site, then correct Russian empty states are displayed without any placeholder content
Given a live environment with published and draft content, when accessing the site, then only published items are visible and drafts are isolated
Given automated accessibility checks, when run on the rendered site, then all UI views meet WCAG 2.1 AA standards for contrast, focus, and operability
notes: Automated end-to-end and component test suite execution across Spring Boot backend and Svelte frontend verified live data integration, empty state handling, draft isolation, and WCAG accessibility standards.
